integrity: Integer-polynomial coefficients and a standalone exact-integer checker accompany the proof; no external mathematical or publication-priority validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact quadratic coefficient is for a four-site open exclusion chain at average reservoir density one half and infinitesimal reservoir-density bias; no finite-bias global sign or large-system limit is asserted. The later sections and appendices of the nearest preprint remained inaccessible.
title: Exact local rectification and the minimal one-defect open exclusion chain
